header: A signed message, addressed to the reader
bodytext:
Rich text set to a letter's measure, closing with a sign-off: an image, a name and a role. The image slot takes either a signature scan or a small portrait, and whichever it is, it renders at the foot of the text and never at the head — a letter that opens with the sender's face is a profile.

The sign-off image is sized by height rather than width, because a signature is wide and thin and a portrait is square, and only a shared height makes the two sit at the same weight under the same paragraph.

The note under the signature is for the date, the version, or the sentence about when something takes effect.
author: The sender's name
note: The date, or when the thing announced takes effect.
